---
title: "Writing cheat sheet"
---

This is not our text. What follows is copied-and-pasted writing help and fill-in-the-blank prompts from ***They Say / I Say: The Moves That Matter in Academic Writing*** (6^th^ edition; Graff and Birkenstein 2024). I think we can improve on this greatly!

## Verbs

-   assert

-   believe

-   claim

-   emphasize

-   insist

-   remind us

-   report

-   suggest

## Scientific paper sections

### Introduction

-   To test the hypothesis that \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_, X measured \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ and found that \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_. Therefore, X concluded \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

-   Although most scientists attribute \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ to \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_, X's result \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ leads to the possibility that \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

-   Experiments showing \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ and \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ have led scientists to propose \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

### Methods

-   We evaluated \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ to determine whether \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

-   Because \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ does not account for \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_, we instead used \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

### Results

-   We measured \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ (sample size) subjects, and the average response was \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ (mean with units), with a range of \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ (lower value) to \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ (upper value).

-   Before training, average running speed was \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ ± \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ kilometers per hour, \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ kilometers per hour slower than running speed after training.

### Discussion

**Interpreting results**:

-   The data suggest / hint / imply \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

-   Our results show / demonstrate \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

-   Our data support / confirm / verify the work of X by showing that \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

-   By demonstrating \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_, X's work extends the findings of Y.

-   The results of X contradict / refute Y's conclusion that \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

-   X's findings call into question the widely accepted theory that \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

-   Our data are consistent with X's hypothesis that \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

**Results differ from previous findings**:

-   One explanation for X's finding of \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ is that \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_. An alternative explanation is \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

-   The difference between \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ and \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ is probably due to \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

**Disagree with previous research**:

-   The work of Y and Z appears to show that \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_, but their experimental design does not control for \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

-   While X and Y claim that \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_, their finding of \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ actually shows that \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

**Disagree with previous research by delineating boundaries**:

-   While X's work clearly demonstrates \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_, \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ will be required before we can determine whether \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

-   Although Y and Z present firm evidence for \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_, their data cannot be used to argue that \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

-   In summary, our studies show that \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_, but the issue of \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ remains unresolved.

**Suggesting further work**:

-   Now that \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ has been established, scientists will likely turn their attention toward \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

-   X's work leads to the question of \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_. Therefore, we investigated \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

-   To see whether these findings apply to \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_, we propose to \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

**Anticipating reader objections**:

-   Scientists who take a \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ (reductionist / integrative / biochemical / computational / statistical) approach might view our results differently.

-   This interpretation of the data might be criticized by X, who has argued that \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

-   Some may argue that this experimental design fails to account for \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

**Relevance (say why this matters)**:

-   These results open the door to studies that \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

-   The methodologies developed by X will be useful for \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

-   Our findings are the first step toward \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

-   Further work in this area may lead to the development of \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

-   This discovery will have significant applications in \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ as well as in \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.

-   These findings have important implications for the broader domain of \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_.
